args: Member order behavior before vs after their first points redemption

Among members who have redeemed at least once, does their order frequency and spend actually pick up after that first redemption, or were they already heavy buyers beforehand - i.e. does redeeming look like a cause of engagement or just a marker of customers who were already engaged?
